_meta.note: DEMO DATASET. Rules are simplified from public scheme guidelines for hackathon use. Every scheme links to its official source; re-verify rules and amounts against the official source before relying on them (see 'verified_on').

schemes.name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
schemes.benefit: ₹6,000 per year in 3 instalments, directly to your bank account

rules.label: You are a farmer
You own cultivable land
You do not pay income tax

steps: Visit pmkisan.gov.in and open 'Farmers Corner' > 'New Farmer Registration'
Enter Aadhaar and mobile number, then fill land and bank details
Complete eKYC (OTP or at a CSC) and keep the registration number

schemes.name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (crop insurance)
schemes.benefit: Insurance cover for crop loss from drought, flood, pests and unseasonal rain, at a low farmer premium
schemes.benefit_hi: सूखा, बाढ़, कीट और बेमौसम बारिश से फसल नुकसान पर बीमा, किसान का प्रीमियम बहुत कम

rules.label: You are a farmer

documents: Land records or tenancy / sharecropping proof
steps: Apply through your bank, CSC or pmfby.gov.in before the cut-off date for the crop season
Pay the small farmer share of the premium
Report crop loss within 72 hours on the Crop Insurance app or helpline
schemes.deadline: Before each Kharif / Rabi sowing cut-off

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
schemes.benefit: Low-interest farm credit (interest subvention available for timely repayment)
schemes.benefit_hi: कम ब्याज पर खेती के लिए कर्ज (समय पर चुकाने पर ब्याज में छूट)

rules.label: You are a farmer

steps: Visit your bank branch or cooperative bank and ask for a KCC form
Submit the documents with the land details
Collect the card once approved

schemes.name: PM Kisan Maandhan (farmer pension)
schemes.benefit: ₹3,000 per month pension after age 60
schemes.benefit_hi: 60 वर्ष के बाद ₹3,000 प्रति माह पेंशन

rules.label: You are a farmer
Age between 18 and 40
Landholding up to 2 hectares (about 4.9 acres)

steps: Visit the nearest CSC with documents
Choose a monthly contribution based on your age
Set up auto-debit and receive your pension account number

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
schemes.benefit: Health cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for hospital treatment
schemes.benefit_hi: अस्पताल के इलाज के लिए परिवार को हर साल ₹5 लाख तक का स्वास्थ्य बीमा

any.label: Your household is in the BPL / SECC deprived category

rules.label: BPL / SECC household, or age 70+

steps: Check your name at pmjay.gov.in or at an empanelled hospital's Ayushman Mitra desk
Complete eKYC at a CSC or hospital help desk
Download or collect your Ayushman card

schemes.name: Free ration under NFSA / PMGKAY
schemes.name_hi: राशन (एनएफएसए / पीएम गरीब कल्याण अन्न योजना)
schemes.benefit: 5 kg free foodgrain per person per month
schemes.benefit_hi: प्रति व्यक्ति प्रति माह 5 किलो मुफ्त अनाज

rules.label: Household qualifies as BPL / priority household

steps: Apply for a ration card at your state food department portal or the local ration office
Link Aadhaar of all members
Collect grain from your fair price shop

schemes.name: PM Awas Yojana - Gramin
schemes.benefit: ₹1.2 lakh assistance (₹1.3 lakh in hilly / difficult areas) to build a pucca house, plus MGNREGA wages
schemes.benefit_hi: पक्का घर बनाने के लिए ₹1.2 लाख (पहाड़ी क्षेत्रों में ₹1.3 लाख) की सहायता

rules.label: You live in a rural area
You do not own a pucca house
Your household is in the SECC / BPL deprived category

documents: Swachh Bharat toilet number if available
steps: Contact your Gram Panchayat to confirm you are on the PMAY-G permanent wait list
Submit documents and geo-tagging details
Receive instalments in your bank account as construction progresses

schemes.name: PM Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0
schemes.benefit: Central assistance of up to ₹1.5 lakh for an urban house, or an interest subsidy on a home loan
schemes.benefit_hi: शहरी घर के लिए ₹1.5 लाख तक की केंद्रीय सहायता या होम लोन पर ब्याज छूट

rules.label: You live in an urban area
Your family does not own a pucca house
Annual household income up to ₹9 lakh

steps: Apply on pmaymis.gov.in or via your urban local body / CSC
Select the component (beneficiary-led construction, affordable housing, or credit-linked subsidy)
Track the application on the portal

schemes.name: PM Ujjwala Yojana (free LPG connection)
schemes.benefit: Free LPG connection (₹1,600 support) plus subsidy on refills for eligible households
schemes.benefit_hi: मुफ्त एलपीजी कनेक्शन (₹1,600 सहायता) और रिफिल पर सब्सिडी

rules.label: Applicant is an adult woman
Age 18 or above
Household is BPL / SECC eligible
No existing LPG connection in the household

steps: Go to your nearest LPG distributor or apply at pmuy.gov.in
Fill the KYC form with Aadhaar and ration card details
Collect the connection after verification

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana
schemes.benefit: Guaranteed pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month from age 60
schemes.benefit_hi: 60 वर्ष के बाद ₹1,000 से ₹5,000 प्रति माह की निश्चित पेंशन

rules.label: Age between 18 and 40
You have a savings bank account
You are not an income tax payer

steps: Visit your bank or post office and ask for the APY form
Choose a pension amount; the monthly contribution depends on your age
Keep balance for auto-debit

schemes.name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
schemes.benefit: ₹2 lakh life cover for a premium of about ₹436 per year
schemes.benefit_hi: लगभग ₹436 सालाना प्रीमियम पर ₹2 लाख का जीवन बीमा

rules.label: Age between 18 and 50
You have a savings bank account

steps: Visit your bank or use net banking and sign the consent for auto-debit
Add a nominee
Renew annually by keeping balance in the account
schemes.deadline: Enrol by 31 May each year for the cycle; mid-year enrolment possible pro-rata

schemes.name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana
schemes.benefit: ₹2 lakh accidental death / full disability cover for ₹20 per year
schemes.benefit_hi: सिर्फ ₹20 सालाना पर ₹2 लाख का दुर्घटना बीमा

rules.label: Age between 18 and 70
You have a savings bank account

steps: Visit your bank or use net banking / mobile banking
Consent to the ₹20 auto-debit
Add a nominee

schemes.name: e-Shram card (unorganised workers)
schemes.benefit: Universal Account Number, ₹2 lakh accident insurance (PMSBY) and access to future welfare schemes
schemes.benefit_hi: यूनिवर्सल अकाउंट नंबर, ₹2 लाख का दुर्घटना बीमा और कल्याण योजनाओं का लाभ

rules.label: You work in the unorganised sector
Age between 16 and 59
You are not an EPFO / ESIC member
You are not an income tax payer

steps: Register for free at eshram.gov.in or at a CSC
Verify with Aadhaar OTP
Download your e-Shram card

schemes.name: PM Shram Yogi Maandhan (worker pension)
schemes.benefit: ₹3,000 per month pension after age 60
schemes.benefit_hi: 60 वर्ष के बाद ₹3,000 प्रति माह पेंशन

rules.label: You work in the unorganised sector
Age between 18 and 40
Monthly income up to ₹15,000 (₹1.8 lakh per year)
You are not an EPFO / ESIC / NPS member
You are not an income tax payer

steps: Visit the nearest CSC with Aadhaar and bank passbook
Pay the first contribution in cash
Receive your Shram Yogi pension card

schemes.name: PM MUDRA Yojana (business loan)
schemes.benefit: Collateral-free loans for small businesses (Shishu, Kishor, Tarun categories, up to ₹20 lakh in Tarun Plus)
schemes.benefit_hi: छोटे व्यवसाय के लिए बिना गारंटी कर्ज (शिशु, किशोर, तरुण श्रेणी)

rules.label: You run, or plan to run, a small non-farm business
Age 18 or above

steps: Apply at any bank, NBFC or MFI, or on udyamimitra.in
Choose Shishu, Kishor or Tarun based on loan size
Submit the business plan and KYC

schemes.name: PM SVANidhi (street vendor loan)
schemes.benefit: Working-capital loan starting at ₹10,000 with interest subsidy and digital-payment cashback
schemes.benefit_hi: ₹10,000 से शुरू होने वाला कार्यशील पूंजी कर्ज, ब्याज सब्सिडी के साथ

rules.label: You are a street vendor

documents: Certificate of Vending / Letter of Recommendation from your urban local body
steps: Apply on pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or at a CSC
Get the vending certificate or recommendation from your municipality if you don't have one
Receive the loan after bank approval

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma (artisans and craftspeople)
schemes.benefit: ₹15,000 toolkit voucher, skill training with ₹500/day stipend, collateral-free credit
schemes.benefit_hi: ₹15,000 का टूलकिट, ₹500/दिन वजीफे के साथ प्रशिक्षण, बिना गारंटी कर्ज

rules.label: You work in a traditional trade (carpenter, tailor, potter, blacksmith, etc.)
Age 18 or above

steps: Register on pmvishwakarma.gov.in via a CSC
Verification by Gram Panchayat / urban body and district committee
Training and toolkit issued after approval

schemes.name: MGNREGA (rural job guarantee)
schemes.benefit: Up to 100 days of guaranteed wage work per rural household per year
schemes.benefit_hi: ग्रामीण परिवार को साल में 100 दिन तक रोजगार की गारंटी

rules.label: You live in a rural area
Age 18 or above

steps: Apply for a Job Card at your Gram Panchayat
Submit a written request for work
Work is provided within 15 days, wages paid to your account

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension
schemes.benefit: Monthly pension from the Centre (₹200 at age 60-79, ₹500 at 80+); most states add to this
schemes.benefit_hi: केंद्र से मासिक पेंशन (60-79 वर्ष ₹200, 80+ ₹500); कई राज्य अतिरिक्त राशि जोड़ते हैं

rules.label: Age 60 or above
Household is below poverty line

steps: Apply at your Gram Panchayat, ward office or state social welfare portal
Submit age and BPL proof
Pension is credited monthly after sanction

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension
schemes.benefit: Monthly pension (₹300 central share) for persons with severe disability
schemes.benefit_hi: गंभीर विकलांगता वाले व्यक्तियों के लिए मासिक पेंशन (केंद्र का हिस्सा ₹300)

rules.label: You have a disability of 80% or more
Household is below poverty line
Age between 18 and 79

steps: Get or confirm your UDID / disability certificate
Apply at your Gram Panchayat, ward office or state portal
Pension is credited monthly after sanction

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
schemes.benefit: High-interest, tax-free savings account for a girl child's education and marriage
schemes.benefit_hi: बेटी की पढ़ाई और शादी के लिए ऊंची ब्याज दर वाली टैक्स-फ्री बचत योजना

rules.label: You have a daughter under 10 years of age

steps: Visit any post office or authorised bank
Fill the account opening form, deposit minimum ₹250
Keep depositing (₹250 to ₹1.5 lakh per year)

schemes.name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana
schemes.benefit: ₹5,000 maternity benefit in instalments for the first living child (plus ₹1,000 under JSY for institutional delivery)
schemes.benefit_hi: पहले बच्चे के लिए ₹5,000 मातृत्व लाभ किस्तों में

rules.label: Applicant is a woman
You are pregnant or lactating (first living child)

steps: Register at your nearest Anganwadi Centre or health facility within the early weeks of pregnancy
Submit the application with documents
Instalments are credited to your account after each health milestone
schemes.deadline: Apply within 730 days of pregnancy for the later instalments

schemes.name: DAY-NRLM Self Help Groups (Lakhpati Didi)
schemes.name_hi: दीनदयाल अंत्योदय योजना - राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण आजीविका मिशन (स्वयं सहायता समूह)
schemes.benefit: Revolving fund, low-interest bank loans and training for women's Self Help Groups
schemes.benefit_hi: महिला स्वयं सहायता समूहों के लिए रिवॉल्विंग फंड, कम ब्याज पर कर्ज और प्रशिक्षण

rules.label: Applicant is a woman
You live in a rural area
Age between 18 and 60

steps: Contact your block / village livelihood mission office or an existing SHG
Join or form a group of 10-20 women
Open a group account and apply for the revolving fund and bank linkage

schemes.name: Stand-Up India
schemes.benefit: Bank loan of ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore for a new enterprise by SC/ST or women entrepreneurs
schemes.benefit_hi: एससी/एसटी या महिला उद्यमियों के लिए नए उद्यम हेतु ₹10 लाख से ₹1 करोड़ तक का ऋण

rules.label: Age 18 or above
You want to start a new business
SC / ST or woman entrepreneur

steps: Register on standupmitra.in
Submit a business plan and choose a bank branch
Loan is processed by the bank

schemes.name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC students
schemes.name_hi: अनुसूचित जाति के छात्रों के लिए पोस्ट मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति
schemes.benefit: Full or part course-fee reimbursement plus a monthly maintenance allowance
schemes.benefit_hi: पूरी या आंशिक फीस की वापसी और मासिक भत्ता

rules.label: You are a student after Class 10
You belong to the SC category
Annual family income up to ₹2.5 lakh

steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
Fill the application and upload documents
Get it verified by your institute, then by the nodal officer

schemes.name: Central Sector Scholarship for college students
schemes.name_hi: कॉलेज छात्रों के लिए केंद्रीय क्षेत्र छात्रवृत्ति
schemes.benefit: ₹12,000 per year for meritorious students from low-income families (₹20,000 at PG level)
schemes.benefit_hi: कम आय वाले मेधावी छात्रों के लिए ₹12,000 प्रति वर्ष

rules.label: You are a college / university student
Annual family income up to ₹4.5 lakh
You scored above the 80th percentile in Class 12

steps: Register on scholarships.gov.in
Fill the application and upload documents
Verify through your institute

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana (Maharashtra)
schemes.benefit: ₹1,500 per month for eligible women (verify the current amount and status on the state portal)
schemes.benefit_hi: पात्र महिलाओं को ₹1,500 प्रति माह (वर्तमान राशि राज्य पोर्टल पर जांचें)

rules.label: You live in Maharashtra
Applicant is a woman
Age between 21 and 65
Family income up to ₹2.5 lakh per year
No income tax payer in the family

documents: Income certificate or yellow/orange ration card
steps: Apply through the Nari Shakti Doot app / state portal or your Anganwadi centre
Upload documents and bank details
Track approval on the portal
schemes.deadline: Check state portal for current status

schemes.name: Gruha Lakshmi (Karnataka)
schemes.benefit: ₹2,000 per month to the woman head of the family
schemes.benefit_hi: परिवार की महिला मुखिया को ₹2,000 प्रति माह

rules.label: You live in Karnataka
Applicant is a woman
Age 18 or above
Family does not pay income tax / GST

steps: Register through Seva Sindhu or at a Grama One / Bangalore One centre
Verify the ration card and bank details
Track your application status online
schemes.deadline: Check state portal for current status
